description: This file defines a PHP class ExternalOAuthProviderViewList, which extends ViewList, and customizes the listing view for external OAuth providers in SuiteCRM. It contains a method to prepare the list view by disabling export and hiding empty data messages.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderViewList
classes.description: A PHP class extending ViewList that customizes the external OAuth provider list view in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prepare the list view by disabling export and hiding empty data messages.
